notes: The Kontext install gets the clock it deserves. Each file in the download list carries its size, and the watcher sizes the pod's deadline from the total — but the Install Kontext button was rebuilding that list on the way through and dropping the size from every entry. Eighteen gigabytes therefore looked like eight hundred megabytes, which is why the progress line said 'around 1GB' and why the pod was declared stuck and deleted after fourteen minutes, most likely part-way through the twelve-gigabyte model. The size now survives the hop, so the same install gets the full forty-five minutes. Downloads also resume rather than restart: curl continues a part-finished file instead of fetching it again from the beginning, so re-running Install after any interruption picks up where the last attempt stopped instead of spending another twelve gigabytes on ground already covered.
